name: Unindexed Triangle Meshing
aliases: Marching Cubes Mesh Generation via Compute Shader
definition: A voxel meshing technique that generates a full cube for every active voxel using unindexed triangles, resulting in 12 triangles and 36 vertices per voxel.
summary: Unindexed Triangle Meshing generates a complete, watertight cube geometry for every active voxel, ignoring neighbor relationships and performing no face culling.
